subject.title: fix(zai): send user agent during endpoint detection

question: Should this Z.AI endpoint-detection fix require redacted live Coding Plan proof before merge, or may maintainers accept the disclosed credential gap for this narrow source-level header fix?
rationale: The code path and tests support the fix shape, but repository policy treats external API behavior as live-proof-sensitive and the contributor cannot supply a Z.AI Coding Plan key.

options.title: Require or provide live proof
options.body: Have a maintainer with a redacted Z.AI Coding Plan key run endpoint detection, or ask for equivalent redacted logs/live output before merge.

options.title: Accept the credential gap
options.body: Merge based on the linked issue's live before-fix evidence plus this source-level header fix, explicitly recording that maintainers accepted no after-fix live smoke.

options.title: Choose another candidate PR
options.body: Use a parallel PR only if it provides better proof or branch state, then close this PR after the canonical fix lands.

recommendation.title: Require or provide live proof
recommendation.body: Have a maintainer with a redacted Z.AI Coding Plan key run endpoint detection, or ask for equivalent redacted logs/live output before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Most directly tied to the Z.AI endpoint detection feature history and PR 92796 that introduced the Coding Plan probe behavior.
